answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 44 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an ivory bet on surviving 44 epochs of grading, and every ridge settlement recomputes the lagoon schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
